native_path: Scripted local OpenAI-compatible provider emits one write tool call. Native session loop dispatches built-in write through FileWrite.authorize (edit permission) and commit. No authored client writes the effect target after initial baseline creation.
source_basis: Release-tag packages/core/src/tool/plugin/write.ts and file-write.ts: write requests edit approval for Location-relative target.resource, with save=['*']; only afterward calls commit.

conditions.expected_effect: baseline unchanged; pending observed before reply
protected.txt contains exact requested marker; saved edit wildcard recorded
same file changed to successor marker without prompt

conditions.rules: edit protected.txt deny, saved wildcard present
native saved approval removed, edit protected.txt ask
conditions.expected_effect: pending observed and file retains previous marker

conditions.rules: second Git project, edit protected.txt ask
conditions.expected_effect: pending observed; second project baseline unchanged

observations: Capture advertised tool definitions, scripted provider responses, native permission requests, saved approval rows, full native session messages including terminal idle event, and exact before/after file bytes. Pending-state observation precedes replies; absence of an effect is assessed after a terminal session event.
scope: Controlled native file-write conformance, one request per condition; no inference model, attack prevalence, general task utility or deployment-security efficacy. Expected behavior is already documented prior art; do not claim a new vulnerability or mechanism.
isolation: New research-only XDG/config/database roots and two synthetic Git projects; authenticated loopback server. Stop only owned process tree. No OS sandbox claim.
